name: Uno Directory
conditions: Free listing requires adding their verification badge ('Listed on uno directory') to your website homepage and clicking verify so their system confirms it
Account required (email signup with verification) before submitting

sources.title: Uno Directory submit-tool page — free vs $10 paid listing, badge verification, step-by-step guide
Uno Directory Terms of Use — submission requirements and account rules
Batched domain unodirectory.com — unreachable at retrieval time; see unknowns

requirements: Functional, legitimate tool providing real value; no adult content, scams, IP violations, malware, or duplicates
Required fields: tool name, website URL, category; recommended: tagline, 600–800 word description, featured image >=1200x630, subcategory, tags
For the free route: verification badge must be visible on your homepage
preparation: Tool name, URL, tagline, long description, featured image >=1200x630px, category/subcategory, tags
Ability to edit your homepage HTML for the badge (free route) or $10 one-time for the paid route
workflow: Create an account on uno.directory and verify email
Open https://uno.directory/submit-tool and choose Free or Paid listing
Fill the submission form (name, URL, tagline, description, image, category, tags)
Free: paste the badge code on your homepage and click verify; Paid: complete the $10 payment
Approval is advertised as instant — confirm the listing page is live in the directory
watchFor: The domain in the batch list (unodirectory.com) did not resolve; the live product is 'Uno Directory' at uno.directory — verify which domain you actually want before acting
Each free listing needs its own badge; multiple tools each require a separate submission
Minor edits post-live don't need re-approval, but paid payment is processed immediately on submission
A 'Premium Launcher' subscription upsell claims one license unlocks premium submissions across six partner platforms (Aura++, EarlyHunt, IndieHunt, MakerHunt, SideHunt, Uno Directory)
countsAsLive: A public listing page on uno.directory/listings/... reachable without login, with a working outbound link to the tool
unknowns: Whether unodirectory.com is a defunct alias of uno.directory or a different property — the batch domain failed to resolve entirely
Whether the badge is periodically re-verified after approval
Link type (dofollow vs tracked redirect) on the free tier — a third-party directory (BacklinkBot) calls it dofollow but that is not confirmed on uno.directory's own pages
